Why PipraPay exists

Half the world can't get a Stripe account.
That's a business problem worth solving.

In 100+ countries, 'just integrate Stripe' isn't an option. Local rails exist — but they don't have APIs. So merchants screenshot their SMS, copy transaction IDs, reconcile by hand. PipraPay automates all of it.

● Before PipraPay

Manual reconciliation hell.

  • – Customer pays via bKash / Nagad / mobile wallet
  • – Sends a screenshot of the SMS confirmation
  • – Support staff manually checks merchant's phone
  • – Hand-types TXID into the order management system
  • – 12% of orders lost, 4 hours daily on reconciliation
● With PipraPay

Verified in 68 milliseconds.

  • Phone app syncs SMS → merchant server
  • TXID, sender, and balance cross-verified
  • Webhook fires the moment funds clear
  • Replay-attack & fraud detection built-in
  • 0% drop-off. 0 manual hours.
The SMS verification engine

The breakthrough that
unlocks 100 markets.

No API? No problem. PipraPay's SMS engine turns any phone into a payment verification node — securely, deterministically, and at scale.

01

Customer pays

Through their mobile wallet — bKash, Nagad, Easypaisa, M-Pesa, JazzCash, anything.

02

Phone receives SMS

The merchant's Android phone (or SIM gateway) receives the confirmation SMS.

03

PipraPay verifies

TXID parsed, sender number matched, balance cross-checked against last known state.

04

Webhook fires

Your application receives a signed payload. Order marked paid. Customer notified.

Developer experience

Built by developers. Obviously.

REST API, typed SDKs in 7 languages, full webhook signature verification, idempotency, predictable error shapes.

One-line install

Docker, k8s helm chart, or bare-metal binary. Run anywhere — Hetzner, Railway, your laptop.

Typed SDKs

Node, PHP, Python, Go, Ruby, Java, Rust. End-to-end TypeScript types from your OpenAPI spec.

Idempotent everything

Safe retries, replay protection, signed webhooks with HMAC-SHA256. We sweat the edges.

Docs you'll actually read

Interactive API explorer, copy-paste recipes for 30+ stacks, OpenAPI 3.1 source.

~/checkout.ts
// :contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0} — server-side checkout import { PipraPay } from "@piprapay/node"; const pp = new PipraPay({ endpoint: "https://sandbox.piprapay.com", secret: process.env.PP_SECRET, }); const session = await pp.checkouts.create({ amount: 1200, currency: "BDT", methods: ["sms.bkash", "sms.nagad", "card"], success_url: "/orders/{id}", }); // → session.url
Security & transparency

Trust isn't a marketing page.
It's the source code.

When your payment infrastructure is open and self-hosted, trust becomes verifiable instead of promised.

End-to-end signed

Every webhook is HMAC-SHA256 signed. Every SMS upload is TLS-pinned and certificate-bound.

Replay & drift protection

Idempotency keys, monotonic clock skew detection, balance-state cross-checks.

Zero-knowledge SMS

SMS bodies are hashed client-side. Sensitive fields never leave merchant hardware in plaintext.

GDPR + PCI DSS aligned

Self-hosted means your data, your jurisdiction, your auditors. We supply the controls.

Self-host first

Your servers. Your rules. Forever.

PipraPay was built self-hosted from day one. The binary you run on your own infrastructure is the entire product — no managed offering above it, no premium tier behind a paywall. Export, fork, and walk away whenever you want.
